Singularity ™ Platform 

One intelligent platform. Unprecedented speed. Infinite scale. Singularity™ enables unfettered visibility, industry-leading detection, and autonomous response. Discover the power of AI-powered, enterprise-wide cybersecurity. 

Build the Right Foundation for Enterprise-Wide Security 

The world’s leading enterprises use the Singularity platform to prevent, detect, and respond to cyber attacks at machine-speed, greater scale, and higher accuracy across endpoint, cloud, and identity. 

See 

Maximize visibility across the entire enterprise. 

Protect 

Defend your enterprise with unrivaled speed, coverage, and efficiency. 

Resolve 

Leverage AI to respond across the entire connected security ecosystem. 

Protect Every Surface with Singularity 

Go beyond endpoints with one enterprise-wide platform for threats across your attack surfaces. 

Singularity for Endpoint 

Features 

Protect every endpoint with enterprise-grade prevention, detection, response and hunting. 

Explore 

Singularity for Cloud 

Features 

Simplify your container and VM security, no matter their location, for maximum agility, security, and compliance. 

Explore 

Singularity for Identity 

Features 

Uplevel your threat detection and response capabilities for identity-based surfaces, such as Active Directory and Entra ID. 

Explore 

Singularity Cloud 
Secure Your 
Hybrid Cloud 

Singularity Cloud Workload Security extends security and visibility across VMs, servers, containers, and Kubernetes clusters, protecting your assets in public clouds, private clouds, and on-premise data centers. Prevent, detect, investigate, and respond to runtime threats in real-time, without sacrificing performance. 

Learn More 

Singularity Identity 
Protect Your Identity Infrastructure and Credentials 

Singularity Identity offers proactive, real-time defense to mitigate cyber risk, defend against cyber attacks, and end credential misuse. 

Learn More 

Singularity Network Discovery 
Control Your Network 

Singularity Network Discovery uses built-in agent technology to actively and passively map networks, delivering instant asset inventories and information about rogue devices. Investigate how managed and unmanaged devices interact with critical assets and utilize device control from a unified interface to control IoT and suspicious or unmanaged devices.
